items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I don’t remember if that was Tootie Heath on there on not. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I don’t remember for sure either.

ctx.x: Yes, Clifford Jordan, Freddie Hubbard, myself, and the rhythm section, right.
It was a very, very good band. I don’t remember if that was Tootie Heath on there on not. I can't remember for sure. [It was Tootie Heath on that recording.]
I don’t remember for sure either.
